title: Latvians made more than 5 million trips last year
summary: In 2025, there were 1.20 billion personal and professional trips made by residents in the EU, a 1.4% increase from 2024 (+17 million trips). Of the total, 848 million were domestic trips (70% of the total) and 264 million were foreign trips within the EU (22%), which means 92% of the trips made by EU residents were intra-EU. This information comes from data on trips by EU residents published by Eurostat today.

title: TikTok risks fine worth 6% of global turnover after 2024 Romania election interference, European Commission says
summary: The European Commission has opened an investigation into Chinese social media platform TikTok under the Digital Services Act (DSA) after the 2024 Romanian elections. The investigation could result in fines of up to 6% of TikTok's global turnover, according to Thomas Regnier, spokesperson for the European Commission’s Directorate-General for Communication. According to the European official, after the first round of the 2024 Romanian presidential elections, when far-right surprise candidate Calin Georgescu came in first place, Romanian authorities sent the Commission classified documents. The documents showed that massive disinformation campaigns had taken place on TikTok, amplified by bots.

title: Student protest unrest spreads across Europe
summary: Police and protesters clashed in Liège, Belgium, on Wednesday as student anger over education costs and school conditions grew, echoing massive protests in neighboring France. Why it matters: The protests are exposing broader anger across Europe over school funding and classroom conditions. Catch up quick: Protests that began in Paris in mid-September as a localized demonstration by high school students have escalated into a massive nationwide movement, with students, parents and teachers' unions demanding more education funding. There have been clashes between French police and protesters in recent days, culminating in a 15-year-old boy's hand being blown off by a police-fired stun grenade.
